correctness.rationale: Proved even-index case via coprimality and odd-index case via a symmetric 2x2 integer matrix whose difference is a−b; because gcd(a,b)=1 the gcd equals gcd(2r+1,a−b). Every divisor occurs using j=2^(d+1)−1, and sharp first occurrence via j=1. Local p-adic primitive pairs yield λ distribution, Reznick Theorem 4.7 supplies its asymptotic and the geometric valuation tail proves global density. Exact independent verifier passed 249,999 pointwise checks, 15 fixed-r spectra, first occurrences through odd 31 and 9 full residue enumerations. No infinite assertion is inferred from finite tests.

evidence: Reznick Theorem 4.7 covers every fixed-modulus distribution of consecutive Stern pairs; its Corollary 2.4 supplies a generic binary identity.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Reznick is stronger on general adjacent-pair equidistribution and directly supplies the imported analytic ingredient. Yet it does not include the key two-step valuation reduction or the sharp extremal claims; those require a separate transformation and a new finite/infinite argument. Density alone would be a natural consequence once the reduction is known and is not represented as an independent novelty.

originality.rationale: Statement-level comparisons to Reznick (2006) and Allouche/Coons (2012) reveal adjacent-pair equidistribution and additive identities as real precursors, but no original source identified the two-step gcd valuation formula, complete divisor spectra, exact sharp first occurrences, or explicit induced global distribution. A new, independently verified two-step reduction and its arithmetic consequences are necessary. Unindexed prior derivations cannot be excluded.
residual_risks: Unindexed literature may already contain the two-step valuation gcd theorem or its full distribution.
The original Coons 2012 paper was accessible as an indexed theorem and via Allouche restatement but not read page-by-page; unrelated undisclosed material cannot be ruled out.
The density result is an explicit induced consequence of published Reznick equidistribution once the separate two-step reduction is proved; independence from that antecedent is not claimed.

value.rationale: This is an exact characterization of a canonical arithmetic invariant at the first nonconsecutive displacement of Stern’s sequence. It determines every stratum’s possible gcd divisors, their asymptotic frequencies, the global probability distribution, and exponentially sparse exact first occurrences/record maxima; these mutually reinforcing structural and distributional facts go beyond simple adjacent coprimality or finite enumeration.
